title: Monster Hunter Wilds Comes to Switch 2 on December 4 — All Title Updates Included, Ascendance Follows in 2027
description: Monster Hunter Wilds launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, 2026 with all Title Update content included, full cross-platform multiplayer support and the Ascendance expansion coming in 2027.
body:
**Monster Hunter Wilds is officially coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, 2026.** Nintendo and Capcom confirmed the release during Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026, bringing the 2025 hunting action game to Nintendo’s latest hardware with the content added through its Title Updates already included.

The Switch 2 release is more than a late platform announcement. Nintendo says players will be able to hunt together through **full cross-platform multiplayer support**, while local wireless play gives Switch 2 owners another way to team up nearby.

Capcom also confirmed that **Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance**, the game’s major 2027 expansion, is coming to Switch 2. That means Nintendo players are joining Wilds before its next major phase rather than after the game’s support cycle has ended.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Monster Hunter Wilds key art presented alongside Nintendo Switch 2 hardware for the game’s December 2026 release.

contentBlocks.text: Capcom has locked in **December 4, 2026** for Monster Hunter Wilds on Nintendo Switch 2. The base game originally launched on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC in February 2025, making this a new platform release rather than a separate Monster Hunter entry. The announcement gives Switch 2 owners a firm date only a few months after Capcom first said it was developing a version for Nintendo’s system.
contentBlocks.heading: December 4: the hunt goes portable

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo says the Switch 2 version includes the content released through Monster Hunter Wilds’ Title Updates. That includes additions such as the **Grand Hub**, returning monsters including **Mizutsune and Lagiacrus**, and the **FINAL FANTASY XIV Online collaboration**. For players arriving on Nintendo hardware, that means the December release begins from a much more developed version of Wilds than the game had at its original 2025 launch.
contentBlocks.heading: A late port, but not an empty one

contentBlocks.text: Monster Hunter Wilds was the first game in the series to introduce cross-play across its launch platforms, and Nintendo confirms that the Switch 2 version supports **full cross-platform multiplayer** as well. Switch 2 players will therefore be able to join the wider Wilds community online rather than being isolated in a Nintendo-only matchmaking pool.
contentBlocks.heading: One ecosystem, one hunting party

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo also highlights **local wireless play** for the Switch 2 edition. That gives nearby players an additional way to form hunting parties without changing the larger online structure of Wilds. Combined with portable play, it makes the Switch 2 release a notably different proposition from the existing home-console and PC versions even though the underlying game and multiplayer ecosystem remain shared.
contentBlocks.heading: Local hunts give Switch 2 its own rhythm

contentBlocks.text: Capcom has confirmed that **Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance** will release on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027 alongside the expansion’s other platforms. Ascendance is described as a massive paid expansion that continues the main game’s story and adds new quest ranks, locales, monsters and expanded weapon actions through new gameplay systems. No exact 2027 release date has been announced yet.
contentBlocks.heading: Ascendance is already waiting beyond launch

contentBlocks.text: The December release date matters because Switch 2 players are not arriving after Wilds has effectively finished. They will enter with the existing Title Update content already in place and with Ascendance still ahead. That gives the Nintendo version a clearer long-term path than a late port that simply collects an older game after its active support period.
contentBlocks.heading: Switch 2 joins Wilds before its next major chapter

contentBlocks.text: The core game remains the same Monster Hunter Wilds experience: players investigate the **Forbidden Lands**, hunt monsters across environments that can shift dramatically between harsh and abundant states, gather materials and craft stronger weapons and armor. Capcom’s pitch has always centered on a more dynamic ecosystem and a story about the relationship between people, monsters and the changing world around them.
contentBlocks.caption: Monster Hunter Wilds brings the shifting ecosystems and large-scale hunts of the Forbidden Lands to Nintendo Switch 2.
contentBlocks.heading: The Forbidden Lands, now in your hands
contentBlocks.imageAlt: A hunter explores the Forbidden Lands in Monster Hunter Wilds.
contentBlocks.subtitle: Capcom

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo and Capcom have confirmed the release date, multiplayer support, included Title Update content and future Ascendance compatibility, but technical details remain limited. There is still more to learn about resolution, frame rate, visual settings and how closely the Switch 2 build compares with the existing PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC versions. Those questions will matter much more once Capcom begins showing the Nintendo build in detail.
contentBlocks.heading: The real question now is performance

quickRead: Monster Hunter Wilds launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, 2026.
The Switch 2 release includes content added through the game’s Title Updates.
Full cross-platform multiplayer and local wireless play are supported.
Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance is also coming to Switch 2 in 2027.
